10. Google Play purchases\nPremium products and localized prices are provided by Google Play Billing. The App receives product identifiers, purchase state, a purchase token and basic transaction metadata from Google Play; it does not receive or store payment-card details. The product ID, product type, purchase token and App package name may be sent over HTTPS to the developer’s verification service only to validate entitlement, prevent fraud, restore access and handle refunds or expiration. Until verification succeeds, Premium is not activated. A verified entitlement may be cached locally, but it is checked again when the App opens, resumes or you choose Restore purchases. Google processes and retains payment information under the Google Payments Privacy Notice and Google Play terms.

14. Premium purchases and subscriptions
Premium product names, prices, currencies, billing periods, trials and introductory offers shown in the App come from Google Play and may vary by country, account and eligibility. The Google Play purchase screen controls the final price, taxes and payment terms. Subscriptions automatically renew for the recurring period displayed by Google Play unless canceled before renewal; manage or cancel them in Google Play. A lifetime product is a non-consumable one-time purchase for the Premium access described at purchase.

Premium activates only after Google Play reports a completed purchase and the developer’s service verifies it. Pending, canceled, refunded, expired, reversed or unverifiable purchases do not grant or retain Premium. Use Restore purchases to request a new check. Refunds and cancellation rights follow Google Play policy and mandatory consumer law.

1. Scope and contact
This Privacy Policy explains how AR Drawing (package com.a02.draw, referred to as “the App”) accesses, uses, stores and shares data. The App does not require an account. For privacy questions or requests, use the developer contact shown on the App’s Google Play listing or the Feedback option in Settings.

2. Data handled by App features
• Camera: After you grant Android camera permission, camera frames are processed on your device while the AR camera feature is open. The App does not use the camera in the background. Photos and videos you create are saved on your device and are not uploaded to a server operated by the App developer.

• Images and files: Images you choose with the Android system picker, images selected in the in-app web browser and generated Emoji Mix images may be copied to App-private storage so the App can display, edit, save or share them. Exporting or sharing happens only after you choose a destination in the Android document picker or Sharesheet.

• Web search and online images: When you use Web Browser, your search phrase is sent over HTTPS to Google Images. Google and Android System WebView may process your IP address, cookies or site data, device/browser information, search terms and page interactions under their own privacy terms. If you select an online image, the App downloads that image URL over HTTPS into App-private storage.

• App preferences and progress: Theme, onboarding status, favorites, lesson progress and sound preferences are stored locally on your device.

• Clipboard: When you tap Copy for an Emoji Mix result, the App writes the result URI to the clipboard. The App does not read clipboard contents for this feature.

3. Advertising, consent and SDK data
The App contains advertising delivered through KiroAds and Google Mobile Ads. Depending on your consent, region and device settings, advertising providers may process a resettable advertising identifier, IP and network information, general device and App information, approximate location inferred from IP, ad impressions and clicks, diagnostics, fraud signals and consent choices. These data may be used to deliver and limit ads, measure performance, cap frequency, attribute installs, prevent fraud and personalize ads only where permitted.

Where required, Google’s User Messaging Platform asks for consent before the App requests ads. Non-personalized ads may still use identifiers or local storage for frequency capping, security and aggregated reporting. The Kiro SDK also packages optional Firebase Analytics, AppsFlyer, Adjust and Meta integrations; tracking and billing are not configured by the App in this release. If those practices change, this policy and the Google Play Data safety declaration must be updated before release.

4. Sharing and third parties
Data may be shared with Google/Kiro advertising and consent services as described above; with Google or another website when you intentionally use Web Browser; with an app or destination you select when saving or sharing; with service providers acting on our behalf; or when required by law, security needs, fraud prevention, or a business transfer with legally required notice. We do not sell personal or sensitive user data. Third-party content, websites and ads are governed by their providers’ terms and privacy policies.

5. Storage, retention and deletion
App preferences, imported references and generated working files remain on your device until you delete them, clear App storage or uninstall the App. Photos, videos or documents exported outside App-private storage can remain after uninstall and must be deleted from the destination you selected. WebView cookies and site data are controlled by Android System WebView and device settings. Advertising and website providers retain data according to their own policies and legal duties.

Because the App has no user accounts, there is no server account to delete. To remove local App data, use Android Settings › Apps › AR Drawing › Storage › Clear storage, then delete any exported media separately. You may also reset or delete the Android advertising ID in device privacy settings. Contact us through the mechanism in section 1 for a privacy request; we will address data under our control as required by applicable law.

6. Your choices and rights
You can deny or revoke camera permission, choose not to use Web Browser, decline optional ad consent where available, manage privacy choices presented by the consent provider, clear local data and avoid sharing or exporting files. Depending on your location, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, restrict or object to processing, or withdraw consent. Withdrawing consent does not affect processing already lawfully completed.

7. Children’s privacy
The App does not provide accounts and does not knowingly ask children for names, email addresses or contact profiles. Children should use the App only with a parent or guardian. The developer must keep the Google Play target-audience declaration and advertising configuration consistent with the audience of each release. If you believe a child provided personal data through a third-party page or ad, contact us so the issue can be reviewed.

8. Security and international processing
The App uses Android permissions, App-private storage and HTTPS for supported network transfers. No method of storage or transmission is completely secure. Advertising, web and infrastructure providers may process data in countries other than yours, subject to their safeguards and applicable law.

9. Changes
We may update this policy when features, SDKs, legal requirements or data practices change. The updated date will be revised and the current policy will be available in the App. The public privacy-policy URL supplied in Google Play and the Play Data safety declaration should always match the released App.

You must not click ads except from genuine interest or encourage invalid traffic.

7. Camera and physical safety
Use a stable phone holder, remain aware of your surroundings and stop if device placement creates a risk. Do not use the camera or screen while driving, walking in hazardous areas, or where recording is prohibited. Obtain consent before photographing or recording another person and follow local privacy and recording laws.

The App may show banner, native, interstitial or rewarded advertising. Ads are provided by third parties and may lead outside the App. Advertising choices and data handling are described in the Privacy Policy. Where a rewarded ad is offered, a reward is granted only after the provider confirms completion; availability is not guaranteed. Do not use tools or behavior intended to fake impressions, clicks or rewards.

9. Saving, sharing and device responsibility
You control the destination of exported files and the apps selected for sharing. Keep backups of important work. Clearing App storage, uninstalling the App, device failure or third-party service changes may remove working files, history or preferences. You are responsible for device permissions, network charges, storage space and any content you share.

We may restrict access when use violates these terms or creates security, legal or platform risk. You may stop using the App at any time by uninstalling it and deleting exported files you no longer want.

To the extent permitted by law, the App and its content are provided “as is” and “as available.” We do not guarantee uninterrupted operation, permanent availability of online images or ads, compatibility with every device, or that references and search results are accurate, lawful or suitable for your intended use. This limitation does not apply where liability cannot legally be limited, including liability caused by fraud, willful misconduct or other non-excludable obligations.

13. Governing rules, changes and contact
These terms are governed by applicable law and mandatory consumer protections in your place of residence. If a provision is unenforceable, the remaining provisions continue to apply. We may update these terms for legal, security or feature changes; continued use after an effective update means acceptance where permitted by law. For questions, use the developer contact shown on the App’s Google Play listing or the Feedback option in Settings.
